aiProfile.title:
What Dalili
knows about you
aiProfile.text: This info is only used to personalise your journey, your mentors and the AI’s answers. Tap to edit.
aiProfile.privacy: Dalili never sells your data. When you ask a question, only your question, the latest messages, your country and your current step are sent. Questions are kept without your name or email, to improve our guides.
